notes: POC focus: GitHub-style PR assistant that summarizes diffs, proposes inline comments, and ranks suggestions by relevance.
Primary constraint: very low latency for in-IDE streaming — devs expect near-line-by-line suggestions while reviewing large diffs.
Model/version pinning is a hard requirement: customers want consistent reviewer behavior across releases and A/B tests.
Customer quote (eng lead): 'If suggestions add friction we're dead — they must be fast and accurate, not chatty.'
Cost sensitivity: engineering org is frugal; prefers predictable committed capacity (Dedicated) but wants a fast Hosted POC.
Data residency: code must never leave customer VPC for private deployment; audit trail required for every generated comment.
Suggested technical approach from SE: prefix-KV caching for repeated review contexts, small specialized reranker model for comment ordering.
SE notes: test quantized variants (70B quant) for throughput and Redwood Optimize recommended configs for batching and cache TTLs.
Legal flagged data retention: needs configurable retention window and explicit code retention opt-out for certain repos.
CSM note: potential expansion to entitlements (SLA + longer retention) if POC meets latency and quality targets.
poc_details: 2-week POC using 3 active repos: frontend, auth-service, payments-service
Eval set: 450 PRs sampled for diff length distribution
Success criteria: latency targets met + product manager sign-off on quality
sales_notes: Upsell path: enterprise private deployment + longer retention + premium SLAs

recent_feedback: Engineers liked inline reranking demo (faster to triage comments)
